column3: O lord of kings (or: king of lords)
lived in the land between the Ganga and Yamuna rivers
by means of the (cotton) rope? (by movement)
from the water of the Ganga in the ocean
going between the two Arjuna trees
should go wishing fearlessness for oneself
you would go, without restraining the senses
with herds of elephants, like a lake
memory even in the elephant birth
the two with elephant tusks as weapons
on the back of an elephant
elephants, Mushtika, Chanura, Kamsa and others
leader of the elephant herd, the lotus-naveled
by the leader of the elephants, the lotus-naveled
of one seated on an elephant
with elephants, chariots, horses, foot soldiers
having the strength and valour of ten thousand elephants
with elephants, horses, chariots and foot soldiers
from Hastinapura, whose feet are holy
like the king of elephants with she-elephants
in the story of the liberation of the elephant
in the story of the liberation of the elephant
sporting like the king of elephants
by roaring cloud-like elephants and men with the splendour of Vidyadharas
with the Ganas, worthy of worship
surrounded by the group of stars, worthy of worship
from the group, beyond the Self
by great-valourous hosts, wishing to kill Nanda's cowherd settlement
by hosts of wind, fire, Varuna and others
nectar of the cheek and lip
with a raised face of cheeks
free of fatigue, said to him
pride gone, they lived in those hermitages
free from deceit by Brahma, Shankara and others
free from deceit by Brahma, Shankara and others, whose sign is inferred
among those whose glory is gone
whose glory is gone, giving up horses and Shaiva...
delusion gone, renouncing, he remains indifferent
gone, delayed, with mind to destroy the enemy side
free of weariness of the journey
with gait, dance and similar, with royal splendours
(they) call the goal inside and outside the three worlds
to the goal of Indra's wife
would attain the goal of lordship
the unseen goal suited to the unreal
the goal, O subduer of enemies
the goal of the Creator, hard to cross
the goal of the wind, O Lord
knower of the course, of you...
by gait, play, glances and the like
in gait, smile, glance, speech and the like
the ways of the unwise here
went, worshipped, the seat of the Fortune of the three worlds
like one who has forgotten the jewel on his neck
I have gone for refuge today
you have gone, where there is no return, to another world
with gait, love, smile, and play of glances
with gait, love, smile, play of glances, charming talk, sport and play
movement, speech, excretion, taking, delight, touch: marks
having gone at the time of hospitality
having gone with groups of apsaras, spring and gentle breeze
the loving ones spoke words of illness? (speech)
struck on the head with a mace
rushing at him with a mace from near
rushing with a mace, from near, thighs
mace in hand, eyes red with rage
when the mace was cast off
marked by mace, conch, chariot wheel
harassed with mace, sword, discus, arrows
in the mace with thunderbolt-touch and sparks
should worship with perfumes, incense and so on
smell alone arose, from that earth
with perfume, garlands, unbroken rice, wreaths, incense, lamps and offerings
with perfume, garlands, clothes, ornaments, incense, lamps, arghya, cows and bulls
worlds of gandharvas, yakshas, men, kinnaras, serpents
among gandharvas, yakshas, asuras, siddhas, charanas, gods and others
of wonderful deeds sung by gandharvas, siddhas and sages
by gandharvas with crowds of song and instruments
by gandharvas, sages, groups of apsaras
by gandharvas mridanga, panava, anaka drums
with mace in hand, wishing to kill
appearing with the Kaustubha jewel mine
with deep waters, floods, speed, waves, foam
praise by Brahma and others of Vishnu in the womb
the world in the womb, heavily burdened
from the drawing of the womb
swelling the belly by the womb
in the water of the womb
placed in the Galasaliya cow-pits, cold
flowing from the throat, very hot blood-wine
in the interstice of the cows' other places
ten thousand cows I want thus the other
of the thick village? (of villages and thickets)
... worthy of the sun until the end of the kalpa
with arrows released from Gandiva, brought
for the destruction of enemies, marked with Gandiva
by body-blows hard as thunderbolt crushing
holding fire and wind in the limbs
shallow-water creatures suffered the heat of autumn sun
of Gadhi was born the greatly splendid
the earth from the water's surface
of the lotus-eyed being sung by women
born of womb, sweat, egg, sprout
Giritra, attained by all world-guardians, Brahma, Vaikuntha gods and Indra
having seen the immortals and demons ground by falling mountains
in mountains, forests, hermitages, wandering with low rogues along the path
of the brother of Shiva, Dhanada (Kubera)
Shiva with the moon on his crown
by mountain peaks, trees and stones
a little, with bashful glance, with a shining smile face, said
from the beloved of all welfare, well pleased by song upon song
with song, dance, instruments and assemblies, drunk
the sound of song and instruments arose then
with sounds of song and instruments
of those who live by song and instrument
with flute-song, with his fame sung by followers
with song, praise, mridanga, panava sounds
songs by sages in the world
with songs, drums, conches and flutes, having mounted the bull
of one swallowed whose eyes roam here and there
with words of varied meaning praised the Lord of the world
with words praised, loving by nature
wearing a garland of gunja berries
face shining with gunja ornaments and peacock feather
diverse by qualities and actions, ignorance undistinguished in the Self, dear
from the multitude of his qualities
home of the multitude of qualities
having reached the ocean of the multitude of qualities
to be described by qualities, births and actions
seer of the truth of qualities
by intelligent ones in the truth of qualities
to the one who has withdrawn, for the intelligent about the truth of qualities
the Self of the three qualities
kinsman of the cause of appearance of the three qualities
without seeing the difference of quality and fault
the view of difference in quality and fault is from the Veda
rule of quality, fault and object in their difference alone
of those whose minds are on qualities
(they) are imagined by qualities, names, actions and forms
is inferred by the illuminations of qualities
nature of qualities, the ignorant, grasped the feet
cessation of the flow of qualities for those
this flow of qualities by ignorance
ornament of the ornaments of qualities
from the lotus-naveled endowed with qualities
than a dog-cooker who is turned away from the lotus feet of the lotus-naveled, qualities
the actions heard of, indicated by qualities
of the nature of describing qualities
in the mixing of qualities, the quality-less
wine of the praise of qualities
whose bodily duties are drained by the nectar of the wine of the praise of qualities
indicated by the functions of the qualities
by the variety of qualities, elsewhere is inferred
disturbance of the qualities of the Self
from disturbance of qualities, so the Self
whose form is mixing of the qualities
of the nature of mixing of qualities
after the mixing of the qualities
from the mixing of qualities, O king
in the mixing of the qualities, quality-less
even in the working of qualities, quality-less
by the mere hearing of qualities
from attachment to qualities takes up
in this mud of attachment to qualities
to him free from attachment to qualities
qualities, you are the lamp of the Self
